reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Cream 50ml Set (+10ml)
reviews.text: The texture is refreshing and easy to absorb, the face is not sticky, and the water replenishment is online. Dry skin is completely dry in autumn and winter, and the base makeup is not powdery, unlimited repurchase.
reviews.zh: 質地清爽，好容易吸收，塊面唔會黐笠笠，補水功能在線。乾性肌秋冬完全冇問題，上妝都唔浮粉，無限回購。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Cream 50ml Set (+10ml)
reviews.text: An excellent cream, especially for oily skin. Can be used both morning and evening. Skin feels nourished, radiant, and hydrated. After two to three weeks, my face contour appears firmer. I'll definitely order more, especially for the summer, when heavy creams are often put aside.
reviews.zh: 一支好出色嘅面霜，特別適合油性肌。早上同夜晚都可以用。皮膚感覺有養分、有光澤、保濕。用咗兩至三個星期之後，面部輪廓望落實淨咗。一定會再買，特別係夏天會更加常用，到時厚身嘅面霜通常會擺埋一邊。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Cream 50ml Set (+10ml)
reviews.text: My mom has been using this cream along with the collagen serum for 3 months now. I added a good review to the serum because it showed slightly good effects at first. But after that there are no good results at all. Even after using the serum and the cream together there are no considerable changes on her face. So I would have to say that it’s useless. Won’t be purchasing again 😕
reviews.zh: 我媽媽用咗呢枝面霜配膠原蛋白精華已經3個月。當初我畀咗精華一個好嘅評價，因為頭先有少少效果。但之後就完全冇再好嘅效果。即使精華同面霜一齊用，佢塊面都冇明顯變化。所以我要講句真嘅——根本冇用。唔會再買 😕

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Cream 50ml Set (+10ml)
reviews.text: Quin gran encert al comprar-me aquest producte. Al ser un gel noto una sensació molt agradable a la meva cara. Noto com me hidrata i canvia el meu aspecte.
reviews.zh: 買到呢件產品真係大成功。係gel狀嘅，搽上面塊面感覺好舒服。搽完感覺到皮膚補水，膚況都改善咗。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Cream 50ml Set (+10ml)
reviews.text: Love this product, still hate the container. Overall I do notice a difference in my skin. My skin feels more hydrated and bouncier. I just really hate the jar and scoop/applicator. The applicator doesn’t fit in the jar for storage so it just kinda sits loose. The little trial tube was waaay better. Hopefully they reconsider the container.
reviews.zh: 鍾意呢件產品，但係好憎個包裝。整體嚟講，皮膚真係有分別，感覺更保濕更彈。但我真係好憎個罐同埋個匙/挖棒。支挖棒根本放唔返入罐到收埋，淨係就噉擺住。嗰支細細支嘅試用裝好用得多。希望佢哋重新諗下個包裝。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Cream 50ml Set (+10ml)
reviews.text: SUCH CUTE AND PRETTY CONTAINERS 🍎😍 The collagen cream has a jelly-like consistency, similar to aloe. I feel like a glazed donut when I put it on (the goal 😍🤣). Since it doesn’t absorb quickly, I only use it at night rather than under any makeup. My under-eyes are extremely sensitive, but I can use this eye cream often without getting any irritation.
reviews.zh: 包裝超級得意同靚 🍎😍 膠原蛋白面霜係啫喱狀，類似蘆薈。搽上面感覺自己好似糖霜冬甩（呢個就係我嘅目標 😍🤣）。因為唔係好快吸收，所以我淨係夜晚用，唔會搽住化妝。我眼周皮膚極度敏感，但呢枝眼霜我可以成日用都唔會刺激。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Cream 50ml Set (+10ml)
reviews.text: Excellent moisturizer, light cream but a bit sticky. I've been using it for a week and haven't seen any change. In the meantime, I'll keep trying and see.
reviews.zh: 好好嘅保濕霜，質地輕但有少少黐。用咗一個星期，暫時未見到任何變化。呢段時間我會繼續試，睇下點。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Cream 50ml Set (+10ml)
reviews.text: when my package arrived, my cream container was kinda busted open cuz the lid wasn’t screwed on correctly :/ so a bit of the collagen contents were all over the box it came in. not sure if the package got jostled around in the mail or it was a production error. thus the 4 stars. anyway, I used this product the last few nights tho and it’s quite nice! leaves my skin feeling hydrated and firm!
reviews.zh: 收到包裹嗰陣，枝面霜個罐有啲爆開，因為個蓋冇扭實 :/ 有啲膠原蛋白霜黐到成個盒都係。唔知係運送途中撞到定係生產出問題。所以先俾4星。不過呢幾晚我有用呢件產品，感覺幾好！用完皮膚保濕又緊緻！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
